title: Intraday Patterns in Natural Gas Futures: Extracting Signals from High-Frequency Trading Data
summary: One-minute NG bars cannot identify first-second timing. Historical forecast vintages are not owned; move on, no weather-actuals proxy.
about: NG Fourier seasonality and weather-forecast cointegration
findings: Authors describe first-second-of-minute trading concentration and season-dependent weather/price cointegration.
mechanism: TWAP periodicity describes execution; forecast revisions could carry information but no tradable net rule is demonstrated here.
build_on: One-minute NG bars cannot identify first-second timing. Historical forecast vintages are not owned; move on, no weather-actuals proxy.
code_feasibility: No faithful directional strategy from inspected abstract; second-level execution/forecast inputs would be required.
